استرأيت (form X)
# اِسْتَرْأَيْتُ (istarʔaytu) /is.tar.ʔaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَرْأَى (istarʔā)
# اِسْتَرْأَيْتَ (istarʔayta) /is.tar.ʔaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَرْأَى (istarʔā)
# اِسْتَرْأَيْتِ (istarʔayti) /is.tar.ʔaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَرْأَى (istarʔā)
